recoveryClosureRelationUnknown.message: Current ownership could not be established; no current authority is inferred

recoveryClosureCapacity.message: One archive slot is shared by the entire installation. Reset retains this evidence and does not free capacity. This page never records, retries, removes or retires a decision.

recoveryClosureHistoricalHelp.message: These settings were saved at the decision time. They are not today’s saved state. Later edits are not appended to this immutable archive.

recoverySourceClosureCurrent.message: Saved configuration at the keep-current decision

recoverySourceClosureRecovery.message: Original recovery retained by the keep-current decision

recoveryAttributionClosure.message: Attributed to the validated historical decision; not proof of current membership

recoveryImportExplicitlyEnded.message: Still recorded as pending; explicitly ended by a keep-current decision

recoveryImportClosedHelp.message: The validated decision applies to this exact receipt. It does not mark it verified, prove recoverability or change the current-state comparisons below. Starting another import requires a separate confirmation in Settings.

recoveryWarningClosureInvalid.message: The one-slot import decision archive is invalid or unsupported. It remains preserved and cannot authorize any current operation.

recoveryWarningClosureUnavailable.message: The one-slot import decision archive could not be checked reliably. Its absence or successful validation cannot be inferred.

importClosureExpired.message: This review is no longer active. Recheck recorded evidence or start a new review before continuing.

recoveryClosureCurrentInvestigation.message: The configuration saved at this decision is investigation-only. It was not retained as a supported recovery-file representation. The archive checksum alone cannot make it importable.

aiContextExternalTasksHelp.message: Paste plain JSON from your chosen AI service: {"tasks":["one task","another task"]}. Use exactly one tasks field, 1–50 nonempty single-line strings, at most 1,000 UTF-16 units per task and 32,000 in the JSON. Code fences and extra fields are not accepted. Loading only prepares a local review; it does not read the clipboard, send, save or execute anything.

aiContextExternalTasksResponse.message: External task JSON (manually pasted, unverified; editable before review)

aiContextExternalTasksProvenance.message: Manually pasted external tasks. The extension did not send a request or verify their origin. These tasks are not linked to the question, selected excerpts or connection shown above. Only the selected task text is added after review and confirmation.

aiContextExternalTasksReplace.message: Load this external JSON and replace the current unsaved response or incomplete draft? Cancel keeps both the current response and pasted JSON. Your question and excerpts stay unchanged.

aiContextExternalTasksLoaded.message: External task JSON loaded locally. Choose tasks, review the selected list, then confirm to add it. No request was sent and nothing has been saved.

aiContextExternalTasksDiscard.message: Clear this draft, including the pasted external task JSON and current response?

aiContextExternalTasksInvalid.message: The pasted JSON was not loaded. Use only {"tasks":["one task"]}, with 1–50 nonempty single-line strings, at most 1,000 UTF-16 units each and 32,000 total. Remove code fences and extra fields. Your pasted text and previous response are kept.

aiContextExternalAnswerHelp.message: Paste a complete plain-text answer from your chosen AI service, up to 32,000 UTF-16 units. Load it for read-only review, then separately save the loaded original to the global AI collection. Check for private information first: saved text joins existing unencrypted local backups. No question or source snapshot is attached. Loading does not read the clipboard, send, save or verify the origin.

aiContextExternalAnswerResponse.message: Loaded external answer (manually pasted, unverified; read-only original)

aiContextExternalAnswerProvenance.message: Manually pasted external answer; origin, model and citations are unverified. It is not linked to the question, excerpts or connection above. Save keeps only this loaded original and your title in the global AI collection and unencrypted local backups. Check for private information before saving. Editing the paste field does not change this loaded answer; use Load to replace it.

aiContextExternalAnswerSave.message: Save loaded answer to global AI collection

aiContextExternalAnswerReplace.message: Load this external answer and replace the current unsaved response or incomplete draft? Cancel keeps the response, title, selections and pasted text. Your question and excerpts stay unchanged.

aiContextExternalAnswerLoaded.message: External answer loaded for read-only review, not saved. Enter a title and explicitly save the loaded original if you want to keep it in the global AI collection.

aiContextExternalAnswerInvalid.message: The pasted answer was not loaded. Use nonempty plain text with valid Unicode and no unsupported control characters, at most 32,000 UTF-16 units. The complete pasted draft and previous response are kept; nothing was shortened or saved.

aiContextExternalAnswerContextUnavailabl.message: A manually pasted answer has no verified request context. It cannot be saved with the question or source snapshot. Nothing was written.

aiContextExternalDraftDiscard.message: Clear this draft, including the pasted external text and current response?

aiContextExternalAnswerCapacity.message: The global AI collection is full or has insufficient space. Nothing was written. Your loaded answer, title and pasted draft are kept. Free space in the collection, then save again.

aiContextManualHelp.message: Type or paste a title and plain text, then explicitly add it. Up to 12 temporary candidates; none are selected automatically. Title: 200 Unicode characters (400 UTF-16 units); text: 16,000 UTF-16 units. Complete input is kept on errors, never shortened. These unverified excerpts stay in this panel until removed, the draft is cleared or the panel closes. No clipboard, file or URL is read. Selecting and reviewing do not save them. If you later choose to save an answer with its question/source snapshot, selected manual text is included in the global collection and unencrypted backups.

aiContextManualAdded.message: Temporary excerpt added, not selected. Current filters may hide it. Select it to review or edit its outgoing text; nothing was sent or saved.

aiContextManualInvalid.message: Not added. Use a nonempty title up to 200 Unicode characters (400 UTF-16 units), and nonempty text up to 16,000 UTF-16 units, with valid Unicode. The complete input and existing sources are kept; nothing was shortened or saved.

aiContextManualError.message: Could not add this temporary excerpt. Check the current workspace and try again. Your complete input and existing sources are unchanged.

aiContextManualRemoved.message: Temporary excerpt removed from this draft. Review again before copying or sending. A previous response and its original snapshot remain unchanged.

aiContextManualClearConfirm.message: Clear the entire draft, including all temporary excerpts, unadded text, selections and the current response? Cancel keeps everything unchanged.

aiContextManualRestoreHelp.message: Restore the exact original text you manually added in this session.

aiContextCollectionReloadHelp.message: Read the latest saved sources into the list below, leaving them unselected. Replacing saved-source selections and edits requires confirmation. Your question, manual excerpts and previous response are kept. This preview is not refreshed. Nothing is sent or saved.

aiContextCollectionReloaded.message: Latest saved sources loaded below and left unselected. Select the excerpts you want and review your question again. This earlier preview is still unavailable.

promptsModelSourceMissing.message: The saved prompt or linked version is no longer available. Close this dialog and open an available saved prompt before sending.

promptsModelSourceReading.message: Checking the saved prompt reference. Wait for it to load before reviewing or sending.

promptsModelSourceReadFailed.message: Could not verify the saved prompt reference. Reload the prompt library before reviewing or sending.

promptsModelSourceReviewAgain.message: The saved prompt reference is available again. Review the request again before allowing access or sending.

promptsModelStreamSourceReading.message: Checking the prompt source. Your completed response is kept here. Wait before saving or retrying the same save.

promptsModelStreamSourceReadFailed.message: Could not verify the prompt source. Your completed response is kept here. Retry the source check below before saving or retrying the same save.

completeBackupExportSnapshot.message: This is the saved snapshot at the generation time below. Later saved edits are not added automatically. No download has been requested yet.

completeBackupExportReady.message: Summary ready. Review it, then choose Download this backup.

completeBackupExportLive.message: Live workspace identities in this file

completeBackupExportTrash.message: Trash workspace identities in this file

completeBackupExportGlobalOnly.message: No workspace module contents are included. The file still contains workspace identity metadata. Each selected global library is included once.

completeBackupExportCountScope.message: Workspace statistics include live workspaces and Trash. Local images count saved references, including repeats. Each selected global library is counted once.

completeBackupExportAnyEnabled.message: Enabled in at least one workspace

completeBackupExportCancelled.message: Prepared export cancelled. No download was requested; saved data and drafts were not changed.

completeBackupExportExpired.message: The prepared export is no longer available. Prepare a new summary for the current selection.

completeBackupExportSubmitting.message: Requesting this download. This step cannot be withdrawn here; check your browser’s downloads.

completeBackupExportDownloadError.message: The download request could not be verified. Check your browser’s downloads before preparing another copy; no automatic retry was made.

completeBackupExportLegacy.message: Single-workspace contents: 1. Live/Trash identities are not recorded in this older format.

completeBackupExportSingleCountScope.message: Statistics describe this single-workspace file. Local images count saved references, including repeats.

completeBackupExportPreparing.message: Preparing a saved snapshot for review… No download has been requested.

spacesOpenNewTabHelp.message: Open a workspace separately while keeping this page and its drafts. This does not change the workspace used for ordinary new tabs.

tasksReopenHelp.message: Choose from the completed tasks displayed when this window opened. Nothing is selected initially. Review the exact originals before reopening the selection together.

tasksReopenKeepsPin.message: Next up will stay unchanged. Reopened tasks keep their stored list positions.

tasksReopenReady.message: Confirm to reopen every numbered task in one save. If any reviewed task or the list has changed, none will be reopened.

tasksReopenChanged.message: The task list changed. Review the selection again. If a selected task changed, close this window and select from the latest list.

tasksReopenUncertain.message: The entire save is unconfirmed. Retry this exact numbered selection; no partial success is assumed.

tasksReopenSaved.message: The reviewed tasks were reopened. Review your current selection before confirming anything else.

tasksReopenHistoryHelp.message: Reopening keeps the original text and record count. It does not restore an old pin or create a new Undo action.

tasksRestoreHelp.message: Choose from the removed tasks currently displayed. Nothing is selected initially. Review every exact original and its restoration destination before confirming.

tasksRestoreKeepsPin.message: Next up will stay unchanged. Each task returns to its original state and stored list position.

tasksRestoreReady.message: Confirm to restore every numbered task to its shown destination in one save. If any reviewed task or the list changed, none will be restored.

tasksRestoreChanged.message: The displayed list changed. Review again if these originals are still current, or close and select from the latest list.

tasksRestoreUncertain.message: The entire save is unconfirmed. Retry this exact numbered selection and its original destinations; no partial success is assumed.

tasksRestoreSaved.message: The reviewed tasks were restored. Review your current selection before confirming anything else.

tasksRestoreHistoryHelp.message: Restoration keeps all original text and the 500-record capacity unchanged. It does not restore an old pin or add an Undo/redo action.
